title: Silhouette of a Shark Swimming in the Ocean

source.author: Mikhail Nilov
source.edits: Re-encoded to 1280x720, 30 fps playback; hand-annotated recording, not a SAM run

scene.gsdSource: Hand estimate: silhouette ~130 px long vs a ~1.8 m shark (±30%); no reference object in frame, so scale is rough
scene.notes: Hand-annotated, not a SAM run. Centre is a placeholder offshore point for the map only; the Pexels page gives no verified filming location, so this is NOT the real location. Small dark shark silhouette seen from directly above in clear water, drifting south across the frame.
